notes: Printed under the heading with 'Acts 2:15-18'; the sermon then says: 'I have not read these words as a text, but as an introduction to what I desire to say'. The editor's edition divides the sermon into eleven chapters (CHAPTER 1 at L79 to CHAPTER 11 at L881). A condensed version appears as 'The Revival: Its Power and Source' in 'The Welsh Revival' (Pilgrim Press, Boston, 1905), held as asset-sermons-morgan-welsh-revival-pilgrim-1905, starting L3239 (editors' note there: 'condense into the following article a recent sermon by him to his people at Westminster Chapel, London').
